title.narrative: RAFFORZAMENTO DELL’OFFERTA FORMATIVA IN STATISTICA DELL’EASTERN AFRICA STATISTICAL TRAINING CENTRE PER I PAESI DELL’AFRICA SUBSAHARIANA
STRENGTHENING THE EASTC’S EDUCATIONAL OFFER IN STATISTICS TO BENEFIT SUB-SAHARIAN AFRICAN COUNTRIES.

description.narrative: L’iniziativa mira a integrare l’offerta formativa fornita dall’EASTC (Eastern Africa Statistical Training Centre), attraverso lo sviluppo di moduli di insegnamento che verranno progettati ed erogati da docenti del Politecnico di Torino durante le sessioni delle summer school presso la sede dell’EASTC a Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

This initiative aims to enhance the educational offer provided by the EASTC (Eastern Africa Statistical Training Centre) through the development of teaching modules designed and delivered by faculty from Politecnico di Torino (POLITO) during the summer school courses at the EASTC in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania.

By 2030, substantially increase the supply of qualified teachers, including through international cooperation for teacher training in developing countries, especially least developed countries and small island developing States
Ensure inclusive and equitable quality education and promote lifelong learning opportunities for all
